name: hihilabs
description: The hihilabs Django app on Tokyo7 (container hihilabs-hihilabs-1). SKELETON: every command is unverified until a human checks it against the real container and sets "verified": true.

commands.name: run_tests
commands.description: Run the Django test suite, optionally for one app.

app.description: app label or dotted test path; empty = all

commands.run: docker exec hihilabs-hihilabs-1 python manage.py test {app}

commands.name: check
commands.description: Django system checks (configuration problems, missing settings).
commands.run: docker exec hihilabs-hihilabs-1 python manage.py check

commands.name: pending_migrations
commands.description: Show migrations and whether model changes are missing a migration.
commands.run: docker exec hihilabs-hihilabs-1 python manage.py showmigrations && docker exec hihilabs-hihilabs-1 python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run

commands.name: logs
commands.description: The last N lines of the app's log.

lines.description: how many lines from the end

commands.name: migrate
commands.run: docker exec hihilabs-hihilabs-1 python manage.py migrate --noinput
